REWORK READY: #2681 (TASK-1782) round 2 at 487bd6dd2d.
Covered all blocking and non-blocking review items:
1. BLOCKING: In agent_stop_in_project, recycled is now strictly !process_identity_is_alive(agent.pid, Some(start)) on an alive pid. Everything else (unparseable/garbage start, unreadable live start, cross-scheme, None, pid<=1) is classified as unknown/corrupt and never reaped or reported as gone.
2. Reworded unconfirmed message to remove '(missing start time)' and accurately describe unconfirmed identity.
3. Added test for live sleep with pid_start='garbage' (Case 1c): asserts Err, unknown/ps -p wording, not classified as recycled, no signal sent, entry kept.
4. Added corrupt entry handling for pid<=1 (Case 1d): reports invalid PID corrupt entry instead of 'kill pid 1'.
5. Factored duplicate PID listing into join_pids helper.
6. Increased trap-ready wait loop to ~5s (500 * 10ms).
Verification: cargo fmt clean, check-portability clean, unit tests 4/4 passed, make check-ci-fast (30/30) passed. CI/Build is running on GitHub.
